memory.scope: Whole node cgroup memory.stat, including all execution paths, prewarming, trie and persistence threads. pgmajfault is not a count of unique pages, and pgfault includes anonymous/minor faults. File refaults are separate counters, not a cache-miss percentage.

observer.scope: Node cgroup, database device only; includes prewarming, trie/persistence, and other node work, not execution-only. Observer gas endpoints align with its I/O snapshots.

durability.scope: Canonical gas crossed by the durable state/trie frontier in the observed wall window. Batched commits are stepwise; a growing producer-to-durable backlog is not sustainable chain throughput. This is not an EVM execution-only rate.
